{{Quote|Most honored Count, Skytop Station is fully active! Only my contacts in the communications cartel could make such a marvel possible.|Po Nudo, to Count Dooku|<ref name="Prelude" />}}
'''Skytop Station''' was a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A modified [[Core ship/Legends|core ship]], the [[Space station/Legends|station]] was designed to monitor [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] communications, thereby providing the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Confederate Droid Army]] with vital intelligence on the movement of enemy [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]]. Skytop Station was built and crewed by the [[Hyper-Communications Cartel/Legends|Hyper-Communications Cartel]], a business group formed by Confederate leader [[Po Nudo/Legends|Po Nudo]]. It was stationed in the upper [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of [[Ruusan 2/Legends|one]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]].

Once construction was completed, Skytop Station began to intercept Republic [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] transmissions, providing the Confederacy with intelligence on the movement of Republic fleets. Following the [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]], [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] tasked [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], with finding and destroying the station. The two discovered Skytop Station's location after receiving a distress call from the captured Republic [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], who was being taken to the station to be delivered to the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Skywalker and Tano traveled to the station and [[Raid on Skytop Station/Legends|infiltrated]] it alongside members of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] with the intent to rescue R2-D2 and destroy the listening post. Despite Grievous's efforts to thwart the Republic forces, Skywalker and his companions were able to disable Skytop Station's [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]] and [[Repulsorlift generator/Legends|repulsorlift generators]], causing the core ship to fall from the sky.

==Description==
{{Quote|We can intercept and analyze ''countless'' HoloNet transmissions. We are the ''ultimate'' listening post for this ''entire'' quadrant.|Po Nudo|<ref name="Prelude" />}}
[[File:Skytop_Aqualish_tech.png|thumb|left|250px|An [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] technician on Skytop Station]]
Originally a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Core ship/Legends|core ship]], Skytop Station was heavily modified by the time it was utilized as a [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]].<ref name="Duel of the Droids Ep Guide" /> Unlike a standard core ship, the [[Space station/Legends|station]] possessed large antennae protruding from both the top and bottom of the vessel. Additionally, massive [[Rectenna/Legends|sensor dishes]] crowned the station's upper hemisphere.<ref name="Duel of the Droids" /> Its interception range spanned the [[The galaxy/Legends|entire galaxy]], being able to eavesdrop on [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] messages as well as monitor long-range movements of [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="What Is a Sith Warrior?">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: What Is a Sith Warrior?]]''</ref>

Internally, the station contained a disassembly chamber for the dismantling of [[Droid/Legends|droids]], as well as [[Hangar/Legends|landing bays]] that possessed enough space to accommodate [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]] and [[Rogue-class Porax-38 starfighter/Legends|''Rogue''-class starfighters]]. The doors to the landing bays were controlled by [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] interface terminals, both within the bays and on the station's exterior. Skytop Station also had at least one room filled with [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] components for storage. [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] monitored the information collected by Skytop Station in darkened rooms near the disassembly chamber. The station was kept afloat by [[Repulsorlift generator/Legends|repulsorlift generators]] that were powered by [[Reactor/Legends|reactors]]; the reactors themselves were protected by a [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shielded]] door.<ref name="Duel of the Droids Ep Guide" />

Skytop Station's complement of Vulture [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] and ''Rogue''-class [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] provided more than adequate defense for the facility. When [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] took command of the listening post, he added [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] and [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]] to its defenses.<ref name="What Is a Sith Warrior?" /> [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] also helped to maintain the station.<ref name="Duel of the Droids" />

==History==
===Confederate service===
{{Dialogue|Kenobi|Our intelligence has confirmed that Grievous's spies have been intercepting our transmissions.|Tano|He must have some sort of secret listening post out there somewhere.|Skywalker|That would explain how he's been able to ambush our fleets.|attr=Republic commanders Obi-Wan Kenobi, Ahsoka Tano, and Anakin Skywalker|audio=InterceptedTransmissions-DoaD.flac|src=<ref name="Downfall of a Droid">{{TCW|Downfall of a Droid}}</ref>}}
[[File:Po_Nudo_-_Dooku.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Po Nudo/Legends|Po Nudo]] introduces [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] to Skytop Station.]]
Skytop Station was brought online in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="ERC" /> in the upper [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Ruusan 2/Legends|Ruusan 2]]<ref name="OEG:S1" /> after the Separatist organization known as the [[Hyper-Communications Cartel/Legends|Hyper-Communications Cartel]] completed extensive modifications to its original core ship frame.<ref name="Prelude" /> The moon was chosen as the ideal location for the spy station, as it possessed an electrically-charged atmosphere that disrupted scanners and prevented the detection of objects within it.<ref name="Dataclip">{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a2505961d961bb0011d9c2424790006|text=Dataclip: Duel of the Droids|na=video file}}</ref> Shortly after the station was fully activated, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], traveled to it alongside his [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] apprentice, [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. Dooku and Ventress were given a tour of the new station by Cartel leader [[Po Nudo/Legends|Po Nudo]], who proclaimed that Skytop Station would be capable of picking up countless [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] transmissions throughout the quadrant. Although Ventress detested the principals of covert eavesdropping that were embodied in the listening post, Dooku was impressed with the station.<ref name="Prelude" />

The technicians at Skytop Station later intercepted a communication between [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of the Republic and [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]] of [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]]. The two discussed a possible alliance between the Republic and Toydaria and planned for negotiations on [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]]. With this information, Dooku was able to [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|dispatch]] Ventress to Rugosa to offer an alliance to Katuunko on behalf of the Confederacy.<ref name="DB-Katuunko, King">{{DB|character|katuunko|Katuunko, King}}</ref> The station later came under the command of the Confederate General Grievous, who used the intercepted transmissions to ambush Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]]. Shortly after the [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]]&mdash;during which [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] lost his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]&mdash;[[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] was able to confirm that a Confederate listening post was the source of the ambushes.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode006.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Downfall of a Droid}}</ref> [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] charged Skywalker and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], with locating the station and destroying it.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" />

During a [[Mission to suspected Confederate space/Legends|scouting mission]] in an area of suspected Confederate-held [[Realspace/Legends|space]],<ref name="Downfall of a Droid Ep Guide" /> Skywalker was attacked by two [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|Confederate frigates]] after his location was revealed by the Confederate [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[R3-S6/Legends|R3-S6]], who was serving as Skywalker's astromech droid after the loss of R2-D2. R2-D2 had in fact been captured by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]] after the conflict at [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. The scavenger had arranged for the Republic droid to be sold to General Grievous. Nachkt traveled to Skytop Station in his ship, the [[Vulture's Claw/Legends|''Vulture's Claw'']], to deliver R2-D2 and collect his fee.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" /> En route to Skytop Station, R2-D2 was able to alert Skywalker to his position by connecting to the ''Vulture's Claw''{{'s}} communication system. Skywalker, who had been rescued from the Confederate frigates by Tano and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], was still searching for both Skytop Station and his astromech droid. He followed R2-D2's signal to the [[Ruusan system/Legends|Hoth's Brand system]] where the listening post was located.<ref name="Duel of the Droids Ep Guide" />

===Destruction===
{{Quote|Captain, trigger the explosives!''"<br />"''But&mdash;sir, we're still in the station!''"<br />"''You just let me worry about the details!|Anakin Skywalker orders the destruction of Skytop Station|audio=WorryAboutTheDetails-DotD.flac|<ref name="Duel of the Droids" />}}
[[File:Rex_hangar_fight.png|thumb|right|250px|The station's hangar becomes a battleground.]]
After the ''Vulture's Claw'' landed on Skytop Station, Nachkt led R2-D2 to a room filled with surveillance posts handled by Aqualish technicians. There, Nachkt met with Grievous, who demanded that R2-D2 be taken to the disassembly chamber to be dismantled and searched for information. While Nachkt dissected the astromech, Skywalker, Tano, and a contingent of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] from the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] arrived above [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] in their ship, the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']], and followed R2-D2's signal into the upper atmosphere of one of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Three Sisters|three moons]]. The group, along with R3-S6, free fell from the ''Twilight'' onto the station, where Skywalker used his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to cut an opening in the station's roof. The Republic forces entered Skytop Station and split up; Skywalker searched for R2-D2, while Tano and the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] set off to plant explosives in the station's reactors.<ref name="Duel of the Droids" />

In the disassembly chamber, Nachkt was able to crack R2-D2's [[Memory bank/Legends|memory banks]], revealing that the droid had never had its mission memory erased. The Trandoshan expected extra payment for the discovery; however, Grievous opted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him and forwent payment. The general was then informed by his spy, R3-S6, that Republic forces had infiltrated the station. Grievous put Skytop Station on high alert and ordered several IG-100 MagnaGuards to move the dismantled [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2 unit]] to his ship while confronting the intruders himself. The alert status triggered a ray-shielded security door to be lowered over the entrance to the reactor room, preventing Tano and the clones from planting the explosives. R3-S6 appeared to be attempting to lower the shield; in actuality, the droid was stalling until battle droids arrived to combat the Republic forces. Although Clone Captain CT-7567, nicknamed Rex, was able to disable the droids, all but two of the clones were killed by Grievous when he arrived. In order to save Rex and [[Denal/Legends|Denal]], the two surviving clones, Tano engaged Grievous and led him into a storage room filled with spare battle droid parts.<ref name="Duel of the Droids" />

Elsewhere within the station, Skywalker caught up with the MagnaGuards escorting R2-D2 to [[Soulless One/Legends|Grievous's ship]]. Skywalker defeated the droids, and together with R2-D2, he escaped to the south landing bay, where he contacted the ''Twilight'' for an immediate evacuation from the station. Meanwhile, Rex and Denal completed the mission's primary objective and planted explosives within the reactor room before rendezvousing with Skywalker in the landing bay. As Skywalker attempted to leave the bay to locate Tano, R3-S6, who Grievous had sent to delay the Republic forces, sealed all exits from the bay and activated several vulture droids that had been hanging from ceiling-mounted recharge racks. The droids opened fire, forcing Skywalker and the clones to take cover near several docked ''Rogue''-class starfighters, while R2-D2 attempted to open the hangar bay doors from an external control port on a maintenance catwalk.<ref name="Duel of the Droids" />

[[File:Skytop_station_destroyed.png|thumb|left|250px|Skytop Station's repulsorlift generators are destroyed, causing it to fall from the sky.]]
As the fight in the hangar continued, Skywalker ordered [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Rex to activate the explosives, although the Republic [[Squad/Legends|squad]] was still in the station. Rex complied, and the resulting explosion crippled the repulsorlift generators and shook the entire structure as flames erupted from Skytop Station's lower hemisphere. Tano, who Grievous had captured, used the explosion as a distraction and escaped by entering one of Skytop Station's air ducts. She joined the Republic forces in the hangar bay while Grievous fled the doomed [[Battlesphere/Legends|battlesphere]] in his starship, [[Soulless One/Legends|''Soulless One'']]. As Skytop Station plummeted from the upper atmosphere of the Ruusan moon, R2-D2 was able to open the hangar doors for the south docking bay, allowing Tano, Rex, Denal, Skywalker, and their [[Unidentified clone trooper pilot (Twilight)/Legends|clone pilot]] to escape the station in the ''Twilight''. Skywalker briefly returned to the crumbling station in [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|his starfighter]] to rescue R2-D2 from the external maintenance catwalk, shortly before Skytop Station met its end.<ref name="Duel of the Droids" />

==Commanders and crew==
{{Quote|Those 631s are not the brightest lights on the ship.|A B1 battle droid, on the inferior capabilities of the [[631 model B1 battle droid]]|audio=NotTheBrightestLights-DotD.flac|<ref name="Duel of the Droids" />}}
As a Confederate listening post, Skytop Station was heavily staffed and protected by droids. Several different models of battle droids served as guards aboard the battlesphere, and it was noted that the [[631 model B1 battle droid]]s that served aboard the station were less intelligent than other droid models. The droids also suffered from servomotor corrosion as a result of the atmospheric moisture on the Ruusan moon.<ref name="Duel of the Droids" />

The station's extensive sensor systems were monitored and controlled by Aqualish technicians. During the war, the station was placed under the command of General Grievous, the [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies]]. Utilizing the information gathered by the station for surprise attacks, Grievous was able to ambush Republic forces repeatedly. However, Skytop Station was destroyed while under the command of the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] general.<ref name="Duel of the Droids" /> This, in conjunction with Grievous's loss of the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], greatly shook Count Dooku's faith in the general.<ref name="Lair of Grievous">{{TCW|Lair of Grievous}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Skytop_Concept.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Concept art of Skytop Station's interior]]
Skytop Station was designed and created for the [[2008]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. The station first appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|online Clone Wars comic]] [[The Clone Wars: Prelude|''Prelude'']],<ref name="Prelude" /> and was referenced to in the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] episode "[[Downfall of a Droid]]."<ref name="Downfall of a Droid Ep Guide" /> It finally made its series debut in the following episode, "[[Duel of the Droids]]," where it served as both the episode's setting and a major plot point.<ref name="Duel of the Droids" /> From a production standpoint, the station's interior consists of one primary hallway, re-shot from several different angles to give the appearance of multiple hallways within an immense structure. Aside from the corridors, ''The Clone Wars'' design team only had to create two new sets&mdash;the supply room and the hangar.<ref name="DVD Featurette">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season One]]&mdash;Featurette 106: Duel of the Droids</ref>

The station also appeared in the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] version of the [[2009]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]''; however, this appearance introduced numerous continuity errors in Skytop Station's history. In the game, General Grievous is not in command of the station during the Republic's assault, which is performed by Skywalker, Tano, Rex, and Denal. When Skywalker and Tano reach [[Sector AA-23]] of the station, all its systems are shut down, including the repulsorlifts. The systems are reactivated shortly afterward when Rex and Denal turn them on via a control panel. The two can then destroy Skytop Station's reactor; however, this triggers a fail-safe lockdown, sealing the clones and Jedi within the crippled station. In order to open the hangar doors and escape aboard the ''Twilight'', R2-D2 and Tano deactivate a control terminal in the station's hangar while Skywalker deactivates one on the station's exterior hull. Skywalker, Tano, R2, Rex, and Denal all return to the ''Twilight'' and make it off Skytop Station. In this version of events, the station is protected by regular battle droids, in addition to [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] and [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droids]].

The novella ''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]'', written several years before ''The Clone Wars'' mentions the [[Three Sisters]], but not Ruusan 2 individually. According to the novel, the Ruusan settlers tentatively observed some "ruins" on one of the moons. The sources haven't identified that moon with Ruusan 2, or whether those "ruins" belonged to the Skytop Station.
